component.name: ONIXPLUS
component.summary: IPTV player for user-supplied M3U, Xtream Codes, and Stalker sources

description.p: ONIXPLUS is a cross-platform IPTV player for playlists and portal connections supplied by the user.
It supports M3U and M3U8 playlists, Xtream Codes API, and Stalker portals with EPG, catch-up, favorites, and external player integration.
The app does not include channels, playlists, or media catalogs. IPTV sources, logos, metadata, and programme information come from services the user configures.
